answer: No. Your records show lisinopril was stopped on September 22, 2025 by Dr. Marsh because it gave you a dry cough, and it was replaced with losartan 50 mg daily. Your cough was gone by the December 2025 visit. The app that still lists lisinopril is probably showing an older record, because one older copy from early 2025 still shows it as active. I found nothing showing it was ever restarted. Your blood pressure was at goal (128/80) in June 2026 on your current medicines. The cough is also recorded as a reaction to lisinopril. Please ask that app to remove it, and check with your doctor or pharmacist if you are unsure. One more thing worth raising at your next visit: your records disagree about hydrochlorothiazide. The hospital stopped it in March 2026 because of low sodium, but your clinic list and your own May 2026 list still show it as active. Your sodium was still slightly low (134) in June 2026.
